name: How do I choose between a flexible and an exclusive listing agreement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a flexible and an exclusive listing agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between these agreements depends on your personal selling style, confidence in finding a buyer, and desired level of agent involvement. Evaluate your comfort with marketing your property, your knowledge of the local market, and whether saving on commission is your top priority. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution will provide an assessment of current market trends in your specific area, like Collier County or Orange County, and discuss the potential impact of each agreement type on your property's saleability and exposure to help you make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your comfort with self-marketing, market knowledge, and commission savings priority when choosing between flexible and exclusive agreements.
